svg.aria-label: Ligasová et al. (2015), Fig. 2, CC BY 4.0, reproduced intact. A: 8 h labeling, mean signal in brightest 5% of nuclei relative to 50 μM; B: 2 h labeling, thymidine-plus-EdU/EdU-only signal in brightest 30%. Error bars are SEM from triplicate experiments. Percentages denote normalized signals.
